projects.name: REA
projects.note: Reverse Engineer Anything — agents + MCP for binary/APK analysis. npm-managed (rea-agents), so a new upstream tag triggers an npm @latest install with a version probe and rollback on failure (auto-install order, 2026-11-17).

projects.name: Craft Anything
projects.note: Craft/build companion to REA — studies a website, app, game, or file, then recreates it and diffs the result against the original. Early alpha. Per Jonathan's 2026-11-17 always-auto-install order it mirrors release assets automatically when upstream ships them (no asset pattern is set yet, so nothing downloads until one is); its source build and coding-agent setup are still only ever run by Muse deliberately, never by the updater.

projects.name: ArtCraft Launcher
projects.note: Launcher for the whole Craft App Suite (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, Craft Anything, and the rest) — installs, updates, and opens every Craft app from one place. Jonathan (2026-11-01): added to the updater and cleared for use as needed on the Hetzner VPS. Per his 2026-11-17 always-auto-install order, new tarballs are extracted under installs/ automatically (extraction is the install for this portable app); the VPS desktop deploy uses that vetted copy when a Craft app is needed. Early alpha.

projects.name: Google Health Connector
projects.note: Ours. Google Health API write path.

projects.name: Muse AI Bypass
projects.note: Third-party catalog of official APIs / public feeds / safer alternatives when a normal route is unavailable (not a bypass tool — its README disclaims defeating auth, paywalls, CAPTCHA, DRM, MFA, geo or rate limits). Mined 2026-11-08 at Jonathan's order: the routes we lacked were built into the public-data connector pack and the Stephany job crawler (see ~/workspace/museai-bypass-mining-2026-11-08.md). Watch only: at add time it had no releases or tags (4 commits, head 868f301), so the watcher records 'no releases' until upstream ships one.

projects.name: McClipFace
projects.note: Coupon/deal lookup skill Muse uses when shopping. Not a forge project: its version source is the remote SKILL.md metadata, compared against the locally installed skill (the install ID in the local skill file is preserved on updates). AUTO-INSTALLED on every new version per Jonathan's standing order of 2026-11-17 ('always auto install, update and upstream'), which supersedes the 2026-10-31 ask-first rule.
